title: The Money-Back Guarantee on Dental and Vision Savings Memberships
content:
# The Money-Back Guarantee

**Guarantee.** A member of a Dental and Vision Savings Membership may cancel for a full refund no later than the money-back period after the enrollment date of the membership. The money-back period is 30 days counted in calendar days from the enrollment date, and a cancellation on the last day is in time. Such a cancellation ends the membership immediately and credits every fee paid, including the activation fee, with the credit reason money-back guarantee, whether or not discounts were used.

The money-back period is 30 calendar days on every membership: Cascade Smile Savings Individual and Household, Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Individual and Household, and Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual and Household.

## How the period is read

- **Start of the clock:** the enrollment date recorded on that membership. The guarantee is judged from the company's record of the membership being cancelled, not from the customer's own recollection of the date.
- **Counting:** 30 calendar days are counted from the enrollment date; the last day of the period is the enrollment date plus 30 calendar days.
- **Comparison:** the cancellation must fall no later than that last day; a cancellation on the last day itself is in time.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Enrollment date | Last day of the money-back period | Cancellation date | Within the guarantee |
|---|---|---|---|
| March 1 | March 31 | March 31 | Yes — the last day is in time |
| March 1 | March 31 | April 1 | No — one day after the last day |
| January 15 | February 14 | February 14 | Yes |
| January 15 | February 14 | February 15 | No |

## What the guarantee does

| Item | Under the guarantee |
|---|---|
| When the membership ends | Immediately |
| Fees credited | Every fee paid, the activation fee included |
| Credit reason | Money-back guarantee |
| Discounts already used | No effect on the credit |

## Basis questions

**A member used the discount at two visits and cancels on the twentieth day after enrollment. Is the refund reduced?** No. Every fee paid is credited whether or not discounts were used.

**Is the activation fee of a monthly member part of the credit?** Yes; the credit covers every fee paid, including the activation fee.
